Specification: This specification models Dijkstra's first published mutual exclusion algorithm for an arbitrary set of processes Proc, using a PlusCal algorithm and its generated TLA+ translation. The system uses shared variables b, c, and k together with per-process control state pc and a temporary local variable temp to represent each process progressing through entry protocol, critical section, and non-critical section. The specification includes the initial condition, next-state relation, and a fairness-based temporal specification Spec, and it defines safety and liveness properties including MutualExclusion, DeadlockFree, StarvationFree, and a stronger DeadlockFreedom property under an alternative liveness specification LSpec.
